description: This file defines the TypeResolver class in the Drupal core configuration schema system, providing methods to resolve dynamic type expressions within configuration data.

classes.name: TypeResolver
classes.description: Helper class for resolving dynamic configuration schema types in Drupal.

methods.name: resolveDynamicTypeName
methods.description: Replaces dynamic type expressions in configuration type names with their resolved values.

methods.name: resolveExpression
methods.description: Resolves a single dynamic type expression using configuration data or typed data objects.
